label: Nothing is simultaneously in act and in POTENCY_1 in the same…, by Constructive quantifier…
rule: Constructive quantifier duality (not exists to for all not)
meaning: Nothing is in act and in potency in the same respect (the Prima Via principle, per thing and respect), from the conclusion of NO-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT-FROM-ANALYSIS (no thing and respect witness the Scotist rival, on the same InAct and InPotency). Constructive; no excluded middle. It adds a route to the premise through the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis (STMT-POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY), which stays OPEN as before; no time index is added or removed.
